wrist_control.feedback: fixed guitar-local wrist origin and xyzw orientation; arm12 only; no pad error
wrist_control.correction_algorithm: raw dq=DLS(qposJ,error); candidate=actual_arm_q+dq; proposal=base+stored_correction; delta=clip(candidate-proposal,+/-correction_step_rad); existing request rate/bounds; correction=request-base
wrist_control.requested_delta_scope: candidate minus proposal clipped to correction_step_rad before combined requested-target rate/bound clipping; inactive reset rows zero
wrist_control.candidate_arm_scope: actual arm q plus raw qpos DLS dq before correction-step/request rate/bound clipping; inactive reset rows use valid proposal=base+stored_correction
wrist_control.target_bounds: actual controller action bounds; accumulated correction clamped without windup
wrist_control.requested_target_rate: existing per-axis controller rate, arm3rad/s; native alpha0.2 remains
wrist_control.jacobian_coordinates: q-position differential: wrist-origin native J times ownjoint qpos-differential-to-native-velocity transform
wrist_control.jacobian_basis: S T = Rparent SO3left(Aq) A; S is ownbody native angular block; FK parent exp(Aq) bind has right-side bind
wrist_control.reset: reset only affected teacher rows; no physics step; reset rows excluded from basis solve and zeroed before DLS solve; inactive actual q replaced by proposal and delta zero; feedforward preserved
wrist_control.limitation: finite feedback target request; actual pose or3s arrival not guaranteed

goal: Each unchanged candidate source-FK L_Wrist pose transformed into prepared guitar frame
control: Live guitar-relative wrist pose error; arm12 request correction only; no pad feedback
unchanged: Finger trajectories, native action bounds/rate/alpha, PD/force, contact and safety predicates
after_failure: Original cumulative safety failure mask disables arm feedback and retains original bounded target hold
limitation: Static diagnostic, not song achievement. Original replay censors each row at first safety failure; feedback traces after that censor are not valid outcomes.
